notes: CONTRACT SPLIT (material): loader main.js v1/v2 (2026-06-16) hardcode 0xCc4B...E61b (currently holds the 7-URL JSON); v3/v4 (2026-09-03, incl. the build publicised 2026-09-04) hardcode 0xfb9B...D277 (get() currently EMPTY). The published build's blockchain layer therefore yields nothing and falls back to DNS/gist/cache (samples/PAYLOAD_TEARDOWN.md s9).

SOURCE-EQUIVALENT, NOT PUBLISHED BYTES: the loader was recovered from the operator's own public GitHub repo wservices66-maker/hello; its build hashes differ from the hashes published on 2026-09-04. Same family and functionality, not the same file. The stage-1 VBS and the published JS bytes remain unobtained.
The July MD5 1e960e47... matches none of the four repo builds - at least one further build existed.

Domains rotate; contracts and the DNS anchor are permanent. chain/DEAD_DROP.md s2: the contract writer set(string) is OPEN (no owner check) - the creator EOA is simply the only key that has written (18/18).
Panel-cluster hosts are one bespoke kit across many domains; the '17 hosts' figure in panel/PANEL_ID.md enumerates to 16 named hosts - flagged in report/CASE_GOOSE_20261020.md.
